title: Scutellarin targets Wnt5a against zearalenone-induced apoptosis in mouse granulosa cells in vitro and in vivo.
authors: Sun, Na; Haseeb, Abdul; Sun, Panpan; Zhang, Hua; Zhong, Jia; Yin, Wei; Fan, Kuohai; Yang, Huizhen; Zhang, Zhenbiao; Sun, Yaogui; Hu, Panpan; Li, Hongquan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药成分野黄芩苷靶向Wnt5a蛋白抗玉米赤霉烯酮诱导的颗粒细胞凋亡，属于小分子-蛋白互作，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，也无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Zearalenone (ZEA) poses severe reproductive toxicity to both humans and animals. Scutellarin has been demonstrated to rescue ZEA-induced apoptosis in mouse ovarian granulosa cells (GCs), but its specific targets remain unclear. In the present study, the potential targets of scutellarin were determined to clarify the mechanisms of scutellarin against ZEA-induced ovarian damage. 287 targets of scutellarin in mouse ovarian GCs were obtained by magnetic nano-probe-based fishing assay and liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry. Wnt5a had the lowest binding free energy with scutellarin at - 8.3 kcal/mol. QRT-PCR and western blot showed that scutellarin significantly increased the Wnt5a and beta-catenin expression compared with the ZEA-treated group, and cleaved-caspase-3 expression was significantly increased in the scutellarin-treated group after interfering with the expression of Wnt5a. The affinity constant (K(D)) of Wnt5a and scutellarin was 1.7 x 10(-5) M. The pull-down assay also demonstrated that scutellarin could specifically bind to Wnt5a protein. Molecular docking results showed that scutellarin could form hydrogen bonds with TRY52, GLN56, and SER90 on Wnt5a protein, and western blot assay confirmed SER90 was an important site for the binding. Scutellarin significantly increased Wnt5a and beta-catenin expression and decreased cleaved-caspase-3 expression in ovarian tissues of mice. In conclusion, scutellarin exerted anti-apoptotic effects on ZEA-induced mouse ovarian GCs by targeting Wnt5a.
abstract_zh: 玉米赤霉烯酮（ZEA）对人类和动物均具有严重的生殖毒性。灯盏花乙素（scutellarin）已被证明能挽救ZEA诱导的小鼠卵巢颗粒细胞（GCs）凋亡，但其具体靶点尚不明确。本研究旨在确定灯盏花乙素的潜在靶点，以阐明其对抗ZEA诱导的卵巢损伤的机制。通过磁性纳米探针钓取实验和液相色谱-串联质谱法，在小鼠卵巢GCs中获得了灯盏花乙素的287个靶点。Wnt5a与灯盏花乙素的结合自由能最低，为-8.3 kcal/mol。QRT-PCR和western blot结果显示，与ZEA处理组相比，灯盏花乙素显著增加了Wnt5a和β-catenin的表达，而在干扰Wnt5a表达后，灯盏花乙素处理组中cleaved-caspase-3的表达显著增加。Wnt5a与灯盏花乙素的亲和常数（K(D)）为1.7 x 10(-5) M。Pull-down实验也证明灯盏花乙素能特异性结合Wnt5a蛋白。分子对接结果显示，灯盏花乙素能与Wnt5a蛋白上的TRY52、GLN56和SER90形成氢键，western blot实验证实SER90是结合的重要位点。灯盏花乙素显著增加了小鼠卵巢组织中Wnt5a和β-catenin的表达，并降低了cleaved-caspase-3的表达。总之，灯盏花乙素通过靶向Wnt5a对ZEA诱导的小鼠卵巢GCs发挥抗凋亡作用。
